session.question: How is the SDG Index used to measur progres toward the SDGs at local and regional level in Romania, and what did the results show?
session.answer:
The SDG Index is used as an integrated, indicator-based tool to measure subnational progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Romania. The authors construct a local and regional SDG Index from 90 indicators, which are stored and processed in a PostgreSQL object-relational database, allowing comparison of advancement toward the 2030 agenda across territorial units. This framework is intended to assess how well different local and regional areas are progressing toward the SDGs. (benedek2021indicator‐basedassessmentof chunk 1)

The results show pronounced spatial disparities in sustainable development performance. The highest scores are concentrated in specific geographical areas, whereas rural areas and the extended peripheral regions in eastern and southern Romania perform worst. In other words, SDG progress is uneven, with stronger performance in selected areas and persistent deficits in peripheral and rural regions. (benedek2021indicator‐basedassessmentof chunk 1)

It reports that Inner Mongolia has made rapid SDG progress overall, but ignoring the evenness of progress overestimates the situation and masks regional gaps. Several SDGs tied to basic needs and environmental conservation (SDGs 1, 2, 3, 7, 12) were positively correlated with ecological water consumption, while economic-growth SDGs such as SDG 8 correlated with industrial water consumption. The study concludes that water-allocation conflicts contribute to uneven SDG progress and recommends integrated planning and management to reduce water stress.

Question: How is the SDG Index used to measur progres toward the SDGs at local and regional level in Romania, and what did the results show?

The SDG Index is used as an integrated, indicator-based tool to measure subnational progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Romania. The authors construct a local and regional SDG Index from 90 indicators, which are stored and processed in a PostgreSQL object-relational database, allowing comparison of advancement toward the 2030 agenda across territorial units. This framework is intended to assess how well different local and regional areas are progressing toward the SDGs. (benedek2021indicator‐basedassessmentof chunk 1)

The results show pronounced spatial disparities in sustainable development performance. The highest scores are concentrated in specific geographical areas, whereas rural areas and the extended peripheral regions in eastern and southern Romania perform worst. In other words, SDG progress is uneven, with stronger performance in selected areas and persistent deficits in peripheral and rural regions. (benedek2021indicator‐basedassessmentof chunk 1)
